title: MM-BRIGHT: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Reasoning-Intensive Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2601.09562v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing retrieval benchmarks primarily consist of text-based queries where keyword or semantic matching is usually sufficient. Many real-world queries contain multimodal elements, particularly, images such as diagrams, charts, and screenshots that require intensive reasoning to identify relevant documents. To address this gap, we introduce MM-BRIGHT, the first multimodal benchmark for reasoning-intensive retrieval. Our dataset consists of 2,803 real-world queries spanning 29 diverse technical domains, with four tasks of increasing complexity: text-to-text, multimodal-to-text, multimodal-to-image, and multimodal-to-multimodal retrieval. Extensive evaluation reveals that state-of-the-art models struggle across all tasks: BM25 achieves only 8.5 nDCG@10 on text-only retrieval, while the best multimodal model Nomic-Vision reaches just 27.6 nDCG@10 on multimodal-to-text retrieval actually underperforming the best text-only model (DiVeR: 3

translated_title: MM-BRIGHT：一个面向推理密集型检索的多任务多模态基准测试
translated_abstract: 现有的检索基准主要由基于文本的查询组成，其中关键词或语义匹配通常就足以满足需求。然而，许多真实世界的查询包含多模态元素，尤其是图像（如图表、图形和截图），这些需要密集的推理才能识别相关文档。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了MM-BRIGHT，这是首个面向推理密集型检索的多模态基准测试。我们的数据集包含2,803个真实世界查询，涵盖29个不同的技术领域，并设置了四个复杂度递增的任务：文本到文本、多模态到文本、多模态到图像和多模态到多模态检索。大量评估表明，最先进的模型在所有任务上均表现不佳：BM25在纯文本检索上仅取得8.5的nDCG@10，而最好的多模态模型Nomic-Vision在多模态到文本检索上仅达到27.6的nDCG@10，实际上还低于最好的纯文本模型（DiVeR：3……
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向推理密集型检索的多模态基准MM-BRIGHT，包含2803个涵盖29个技术领域的真实查询和四种复杂度递增的检索任务，评估显示现有最先进模型在所有任务上表现都很差。
